draft.subject: Searchanise — Japan rollout for Shopify apparel retailers
draft.body:
Hi Searchanise team,

We’re A-one Road, a Yokohama-based company helping technology companies develop their Japan business. We see a specific opportunity for Searchanise in catalog search for Japanese Shopify apparel retailers, which is why we’re reaching out.

Japan’s May 2026 labour survey found regular-staff shortages at 34% of surveyed wholesale/retail establishments. For lean apparel teams, improving catalog search could reduce the manual work needed to keep products discoverable.

We can lead one year of paid Japan market development focused on this workflow, including buyer interviews, local requirements, and a practical route to market. Japanese buyer feedback would shape application priorities and local rollout. Can we help build Searchanise’s Japan expansion around these retailers?

https://calendar.app.google/adKEhXC4UWhQXfJp6

Best regards,
Kazuma Tamura
Founder & CEO, A-one Road Co., Ltd. (Yokohama, Japan)
